# Daisyworld: динамика числа маргариток
График изменения числа чёрных и белых маргариток во времени.

## Загрузка

```{julia}
import Pkg
Pkg.activate("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab03/project")
using DrWatson

using Agents
using DataFrames
using Plots
using CairoMakie

ENV["GKSwstype"] = "100"

include("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab03/project/src/daisyworld.jl")

script_name = "daisyworld-count"
mkpath(plotsdir(script_name))
mkpath(datadir(script_name))
```

## Данные агентов

```{julia}
black(a) = a.breed == :black
white(a) = a.breed == :white
adata = [(black, count), (white, count)]
```

## Модель и запуск

```{julia}
model = daisyworld(; solar_luminosity = 1.0)
agent_df, model_df = run!(model, 1000; adata)
```

## Визуализация (CairoMakie)

```{julia}
figure = Figure(size = (600, 400))
ax = figure[1, 1] = Axis(figure, xlabel = "tick", ylabel = "daisy count")
blackl = lines!(ax, agent_df[!, :time], agent_df[!, :count_black], color = :black)
whitel = lines!(ax, agent_df[!, :time], agent_df[!, :count_white], color = :orange)
Legend(figure[1, 2], [blackl, whitel], ["black", "white"], labelsize = 12)
```

## Сохранение

```{julia}
save(plotsdir(script_name, "daisy_count.png"), figure)

println("График сохранён!")
```
